svg.title: Four chains started apart, and the pooled draws against the exact posterior
svg.desc: Left: four chains beginning at 1, 3, 7 and 10 all settle into the same band near 5 within a few dozen iterations, with the first five hundred iterations shaded as warm-up. Right: a histogram of the kept draws sitting under the exact Gamma density.
svg.text: Kept draws against the exact density
Chains started far apart ending in one band is evidence the algorithm found that region, and the histogram stands in for the posterior.
All four settle within a few dozen iterations, so discarding the shaded first 500 of each is a generous margin rather than a tight one.
Neither panel says the Gamma-Poisson model is right for the help desk. That question belongs to Week 11.
